scene: A neon upside-down city swirls deep inside the glassy puddle.
picture: A close first-person view peering down into the large clear rainwater puddle. Two yellow-sleeved hands hover near the rim. On the left, a hypnotic circular ripple distorts neon tower reflections. In the centre drifts a glowing yellow paper boat. On the right, visible through clear water, rests a gleaming bronze key.
shown: a deep ripple forming in the puddle water on the left
a tiny glowing origami boat floating in the centre
a shiny bronze key resting on the pool bed on the right
